guardMessage: migrate may only be called by the contract account itself

checks.name: the compiled v2 wasm is deployed on the sandbox
the contract is initialised with the real owner
a third-party migrate() is REFUSED (SEC-1 closed)
the owner is unchanged after the refused migrate
the contract state is unchanged after the refused migrate
a repeated third-party migrate() is still refused
the contract account itself may migrate() (self-call)
the self-call migrate re-initialised the contract
